title: XCP CAN Data Stimulation
text: Perform data stimulation on selected measurements, 1 input, {Block Input Settings} sets the port input as Compu method conversion values or raw values Raw values as double; {Config name} sets the xCP CAN session name select, {Event name} selects an event select, {All Measurements} sets the list all measurements available for event measurements, {Selected Measurements} sets the list selected measurements measurement and {Enable Timestamp} enables sending Simulink timestamp in STIM DTO. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Input samples for data stimulation defined by A2L file

params.name: Config name
params.values: Specify XCP CAN session name select from list

params.name: Event name
params.values: Select an event select from list

params.name: All Measurements
params.values: List all measurements available for event measurements list

params.name: Block Input Settings
params.values: Set the port input as Compu method conversion values or raw values Raw values as double (no Compu method conversion) (default) | Raw values (no Compu method conversion) | Physical values (apply Compu method conversion)

params.name: Enable Timestamp
params.values: Enable sending Simulink timestamp in STIM DTO packets off (default) | on
